description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin class 'MediaImageTextAlternativeEditing' that extends the base Plugin class. It manages schema extension for 'drupalMedia', handles display of metadata error messages related to Drupal media, and registers a command for media image text alternative editing.

classes.name: MediaImageTextAlternativeEditing
classes.description: A CKEditor plugin class for editing media image text alternatives, handling metadata errors, and integrating with Drupal media metadata.

methods.name: requires
methods.description: Returns dependencies required by the plugin, specifically 'DrupalMediaMetadataRepository'.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin: extends schema, sets up conversion for error display, and adds the media image text alternative command.
